dataset_name: Korean AI Curriculum — Stage 1 Split Manifest

held-out_v1_archive.description: held-out_v2의 이전 버전 benchmark lineage를 보존하기 위한 legacy archive. 학습, validation, checkpoint selection, hyperparameter tuning, model selection, final benchmark에 사용하지 않는다.

roles.train: Stage 1 집중학습에 사용되는 900개. 모델 가중치 업데이트에 사용한다.
roles.val: Stage 1 학습 중 validation 및 checkpoint/hyperparameter 선택에 사용하는 100개. gradient update에는 사용하지 않는다.
roles.held-out_v2: 학습 및 validation과 완전히 분리된 최종 semantic benchmark 300개. benchmark v2 형식의 forced-choice / likelihood probe로 사용한다.
roles.held-out_v1_archive: held-out_v2의 이전 benchmark 버전을 보존하기 위한 legacy archive. 실험 데이터로 사용하지 않는다.

legacy_benchmark.reason: held-out_v1과 held-out_v2는 동일 benchmark lineage에 있으며 v2가 v1의 내용을 확장·변환한 버전이므로, v1을 validation으로 재사용하면 v2의 최종 독립성을 훼손할 수 있다.

rules: train + val = the original 1,000-example Stage 1 prototype.
held-out_v2 is a separate 300-example benchmark and is not part of the 1,000-example Stage 1 prototype.
held-out_v2 must not be used for checkpoint selection, hyperparameter tuning, curriculum modification, or model selection.
actual Stage 1 training should read train/stage1_train_text_900.jsonl only.
held-out_v2 benchmark evaluation should read only the held-out_v2 benchmark files after the final model/checkpoint has been fixed.
held-out_v2 benchmark results must not be fed back into training, validation, hyperparameter search, or curriculum design.
train, val, and held-out_v2 splits must have disjoint record IDs.
the held-out_v2 benchmark should use its benchmark-specific scoring schema rather than the older free-generation scoring schema.
held-out_v1_archive must not be moved into train or val and must not be used for checkpoint selection, hyperparameter tuning, model selection, or final benchmark evaluation.
held-out_v1_archive and held-out_v2 belong to the same benchmark lineage; therefore held-out_v1_archive is archival only and cannot serve as an independent validation or test split.
held-out_v2 is the only benchmark split eligible for final benchmark reporting.

once held-out_v2 results are inspected and used to change training, checkpoint selection, hyperparameters, curriculum, data composition, model architecture, or model selection, that evaluation instance is no longer a blind final test and must be treated as a development evaluation rather than a final benchmark result.

benchmark.purpose: Stage 1의 새로운 개념·관계·경계 일반화 능력을 외부 LLM judge 없이 평가한다.
